data.question: Write a program that reads X. When X is greater than 30 and at most 50, print "X is Greater than 30"; otherwise print both "X is Greater than 30" and "X is Greater than 50".

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads X. When X is greater than 30 and at most 50, print "X is Greater than 30"; otherwise print both "X is Greater than 30" and "X is Greater than 50".

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: The else branch prints both lines regardless of the value, including values below 30.
